prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / premium food advertising.
Generate ONE exquisite, photorealistic advertising photograph of an imagined future Korean instant-rice product, not a collage. Vertical 4:5 canvas, width:height 0.8, ideally 1600x2000. NO letters, NO logos, NO brand labels. Leave the top 24% as calm warm ivory space for typography later.

Concept: "One table, each person's own bowl." A genuinely new modular rice-sharing format, not a selection of unrelated products and not a magical house. Four INDIVIDUALLY SEALED and detachable rice bowls connect around a small shared side-dish plate to form the outline of ONE generous circular rice bowl. From a distance the product looks like one circle; up close it is four distinct independently usable bowls. The product's geometry must make the idea visible.

Camera: refined nearly overhead food/industrial-design photograph, 75-degree downward angle, natural tactile warm birch tabletop. The product fills the lower two thirds, approx 72% of frame width. Precise beautiful geometry and luscious real food are the heroes, with just three families of objects: the four-part rice vessel, the single central shared side-dish platter, and a few hands/spoons that demonstrate independent choice and sharing. No full faces, no bodies, no scenery, no architecture or holograms.

The imagined vessel: four shallow white microwave-safe rice trays shaped as rounded annular sectors, like soft quarter-ring arcs, smoothly interlocking end-to-end into one outer circle about 38cm across, around one round central plate about 13cm diameter. Each rice compartment has a CLOSED inner and outer wall so it is its own usable bowl, independent peel seal, and a small discrete physical nesting joint beneath the rim. Their portions are visibly unequal but elegant: a larger section of glossy fresh short-grain white rice, one of appetizing mixed grains with golden and russet grains, one of beautiful purple black-rice mix, one smaller section of soft white rice. They are different rice choices, not medicinal food. No health symbolism or medical claims. Natural individual slightly elongated cooked grains, irregular plump surfaces, restrained moist gloss, not round foam pellets. Very faint warm steam.

Make the functional reveal clear: the BOTTOM-RIGHT white-rice module is gently sliding outward 3cm in an adult hand so there is a visible narrow clean gap and the module's independent curved inner wall can be seen; its remaining upper rim precisely matches the circle it came from. Its thin plain matte-silver foil is HALF PEELED, revealing the fresh rice. The other three compartments remain neatly arranged around the shared center, and have their own tiny distinct foil pull tabs, with one more gently opened but NO huge foil ribbons. No material spans over the rice or turns into furniture. At the TOP-LEFT a different adult hand holds a simple spoon over the mixed-grain section. On the right a third hand's pair of slim chopsticks reaches toward the SINGLE central side dish, showing that the center is still shared. Only these three partial anatomically convincing hands; no extra cutlery.

The central plate contains carefully arranged appetizing Korean side dishes in a SINGLE plate: a small portion of vivid kimchi, yellow rolled omelet and emerald greens, visually neat and realistic, not a restaurant banquet. The central shared food MUST be visible and must not look like the bowl's lid or a decorative disc.

Art direction: premium editorial food photography and plausible forward-looking industrial design, quiet warm ivory and wood with vivid food colors, satin white packaging, controlled soft natural sunlight from upper left, nuanced contact shadows, generous breathing space. The product has gentle organic asymmetry rather than a rigid catering tray. It should feel desirable, personal and inviting, not clinical, not a lab dish, not a toy. Sophisticated unexpected circular reveal; clear functional story, delicious food. Every tray has realistic sealed edges and smooth clean manufacturing details.

Constraints: SINGLE 4:5 photo. No logo, no text, no watermarks, no typography. No hovering/floating parts, no impossible melted joins, no plastic mixed into food, no miniatures or people on food, no generically futuristic lights/screens. Do NOT simply photograph four ordinary round bowls: the interlocking annular-sector geometry is essential and must be beautifully legible.

Refine this premium food photograph with ONE targeted correction: make the bottom-right independent rice bowl visibly being OPENED rather than merely held.
Keep the exact 4:5 layout, warm ivory empty top quarter, four interlocking curved independent rice trays, four rice choices, circular shared center plate with kimchi/omelet/greens, spoon at upper left, chopsticks picking central kimchi at right, and all food colors and natural lighting.

At bottom right the detached white-rice module is resting steadily on the wooden tabletop 4cm out from the circular assembly. It is a normal personal rice bowl with a clearly CLOSED white inner curved wall, not an exposed wedge of rice. The hand coming from the bottom right should have a believable thumb and index finger clearly PINCHING THE DRY OUTER PULL TAB of the thin plain silver peel film, lifting it up/back about 4cm to reveal warm real cooked rice. Make the natural hinge line of the film and where it is still sealed unambiguous. The other fingers stay relaxed outside the food. The hand does not enter the rice, touch the wet inner film or grip the bowl from inside. The peeled film remains small and physically convincing, no large ribbon. Preserve the existing closed front rim and the subtle tiny alignment joint on the outside of the module; no strange extra locking parts.

The other three modules each visibly have their OWN separate small peeled-film remainder and clean closed rim. It should read as four independent bowls that can be opened separately, sharing a center plate, rather than a one-piece compartment lunch tray. Maintain different appetizing cooked grain colors, subtle elongated varied grains, natural moisture. Very faint delicate steam, never smoke. Preserve the main image composition and everything outside this local hand/tab/bowl correction. Do not add a fourth hand or extra objects, faces, typography, logos or labels. No stylistic change.
